        .text
        .globl  val
        .type   val,@function
val:    movl    $42, %eax
        ret
        .size   val, .-val
        .globl  call_deep
        .type   call_deep,@function
call_deep:
        jmp     *deep_fn@GOTPCREL(%rip)
        .size   call_deep, .-call_deep
        .data
        .globl  val_table
val_table:
        .quad   val
        .quad   val_table
        .section .note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits
